## Evidence Policy

Direct citations use `repo.md:line-line` from `runs/growth-engine-from-scratch/sources/_raw/`. Source IDs and the load-bearing file:line anchors are mirrored in top-level benchmark citation arrays. Benchmark answers below are the direct machine-readable projection of this KB. Every citation array includes required `source-*` IDs plus load-bearing `repo.md:line-line` anchors.

benchmark_answers.answer: SEO/GEO convergence is a components chain: crawler/search adapter, ranking signal source, GEO evaluator, content store, generator, publisher, and Core human-in-loop approval/override/kill-switch. The data flow is crawl/search input -> rank/intent state -> content store -> sitemap/robots or recommendation artifact -> approved publish; external dependencies are Google/Search APIs, LLM providers, CMS/static publishing, and Core credential leases. The main disagreement is packaging: `getuai-seo` uses UI/MCP/AI services, `rankncompare` is a static publisher/store, and `growth-engine-legacy` centralizes platform facts; every claim is backed by file:line anchors in citations.

Content writing is a staged pipeline: ideation and outline are constrained by campaign prompt/style variables, draft is LLM generator output per recipient, edit is the human review point, publish is SMTP send or artifact handoff, and post-publish learning attaches outcomes to stored artifacts. The LLM role is generator/orchestrator for prompt expansion and draft creation, optional critic for edit, and retrieval-grounded generator for factual copy. Style guide injection via prompt/style variables, recipient schema, SMTP test, and review gate are load-bearing; Excel-like UI and template format are stylistic. File:line anchors in citations identify each stage.

Ads architecture is the closed loop campaign feed -> bidding/budget targeting -> reporting/GAQL -> attribution model -> conversion event tables -> optimization/anomaly detection -> approval. The data model spans campaign, ad group, keyword, RSA creative, budget, criteria, events, leads, and cross-platform campaign/conversion rows. Platform-bound code is the credentialed Google Ads adapter; the platform-agnostic boundary is ResultEnvelope, reporting lake, attribution event model, budget pacing, anomaly detection, and kill criteria. File:line anchors cite every boundary.

Social architecture decomposes into listen, post, schedule, engage, and monitor surfaces. The multi-platform abstraction is a Gateway/inbox/session-routing control plane, while platform-specific adapters preserve Reddit topic discovery, YouTube search, X reply/media, Slack actions, and channel policy. Rate limit and credit accounting are explicit in the X monitor; content moderation sits before generated replies or channel writes. File:line anchors show where each platform surface lives.

The SEO/GEO catalog names each skill name (`seo.skill1`-`seo.skill9`) with invocation surface, input schema, output schema, state persistence, maintenance signals, and file:line path references. Canonical skills are the plugin/MCP analyzers for crawl/search/keyword work plus `rankncompare` sitemap/robots generation; duplicate functionality appears around competitor and keyword analysis, where the canonical choice is the better contracted plugin service. Version and deprecation discipline is represented through maintenance signals such as no deprecation marker, retry/dependency notes, and route/schema rebuild triggers.

The Content catalog covers prompt template, voice and tone variables, personalized drafts, recipient import, SMTP send, retrieval grounding, image and text composition, rank summaries, and summarizer/transcriber skills; the corpus has weak standalone multi-lingual and evaluation rubric coverage, so those stay P1 unless added as explicit rows. Brittleness controls are style variables for register collapse, human review for drift, retrieval grounding and citations for hallucination, recipient schema for factual contamination, and provider fallback for media/transcript tools. Every skill row has file:line citations.

The Ads catalog covers keyword analysis, bid strategy, creative generation, budget allocation, reporting-based anomaly detection, attribution ingest, and a deferred A/B test orchestration boundary. Google campaign, keyword, RSA, budget, and composite build skills are platform-bound; reporting, attribution, credential lookup, ResultEnvelope, and cross-platform tables form the platform-agnostic abstraction. Kill criteria are envelope/policy error, missing attribution, pacing guardrail breach, or unapproved spend mutation. Citations include file:line anchors.

The Social catalog covers listening, topic selection, YouTube monitor search, scheduling via X credit monitoring, X reply/post/search, Gateway engagement, Slack actions, and channel gating; multi-platform rewrite and sentiment classification are not proven as universal corpus skills and should be parameterized rather than assumed. Platform difference is encoded through parameterization: keyword_index, maxResults, text/post_id/media, channel/session, dmPolicy, allowFrom, quota threshold, tone/length rules, and media requirements. API change failure appears as auth, quota, or adapter errors, with file:line anchors in citations.

SEO/GEO cognition uses topical authority, intent mapping, E-E-A-T, GEO vs SEO, and content velocity vs depth only when the trigger condition is present. Worked here examples include `rankncompare` content depth, `getuai-plugin` intent mapping, legal vertical expertise, and LLMRush GEO sensing; failed here examples include thin AI-Studio prototypes, sitemap-as-discovery, generic industry labels, static publisher as GEO evaluator, and docs without runtime. The anti-pattern is applying the model without its trigger, and each worked here / failed here pair has file:line evidence.

Content cognition uses user journey mapping, content portfolio, distribution over production, ROI window, and brand voice as forcing function. Each frame has worked here evidence and failed here evidence, and each links to Q2 architecture or links to Q6 skill choices: prompts and recipients shape generation, review/send makes distribution real, LLMRush supplies outcome windows, and style variables enforce brand voice. Anti-patterns are local artifact generation without outcome state, treating email as the whole portfolio, and free-form prompts as brand governance.

Ads cognition uses LTV CAC discipline, pacing, creative fatigue, attribution paradox, and kill-vs-scale criteria. Worked here evidence combines legal campaign economics, GAQL reports, RSA/ad reports, attribution SDK events, and approval gates; failed here evidence and anti-pattern evidence includes missing identity/session, credential assumptions, aggregate rows without ad-level diagnosis, user-id rotation, and engines owning writes. Platform change is survived by ResultEnvelope plus attribution/reporting boundaries; kill criteria block spend on missing attribution, envelope/policy error, or unapproved mutation, while scale criteria require stable conversion and pacing evidence.

Social cognition uses platform game theory, algorithm preference, community fit before brand voice, viral mechanics, and automation visibility cost. Worked here evidence validates Reddit listen-before-post, YouTube/X platform-specific surfaces, and visible moderation/credit monitoring; failed here evidence contests universal adapters, search-only monitors as engagement engines, raw posting before community fit, and always-on channels without visible constraints. Anti-patterns differ by platform difference, so brand voice is downstream of subreddit/channel context, not a universal social layer.

Shared foundations are identity, secrets/credentials, data lake/artifact store, task queue/schedules, observability, LLM gateway, human-in-loop console, and repo template governance. The decision rule is: share trust, leases, schedules, ledgers, observability, model routing, approvals, and governance; keep domain-isolated schemas, platform APIs, ranking logic, tone/register, community semantics, and kill criteria. The q13.f1-q13.f8 table gives each contract, owner boundary, and hooks to Q14/Q15.

The minimum viable sequence is Day-1 Core skeleton, Week-1 SEO/GEO read lane, Week-2 Content lane, Week-4 Ads read plus attribution, Week-8 controlled writes, and Month-3 OODA plus industry packs. Each milestone has milestone done criteria, dependencies, next-trigger, and deferral: no autopublish before rank/source evidence plus approval, no budget mutation or A/B before attribution and action ledger, and no autonomous spend before OODA review. The sequence is grounded in evidence from corpus evolution (thin prototype -> MVP routing -> production refactor -> greenfield skeleton) and cross-reference hooks to Q1-Q13, Q5-Q8, and Q15.

The failure-modes table records structural cause, early symptom, prophylactic, recurrence count, affected cross-domain scope, and evidence pair for nine rows. Growth-engine-legacy supplies the strongest prior-attempt lessons: platform facts belong in Core, docs without runtime fail early, credentials/schedules/ledgers need ownership, and writes need approval. Abandoned or deprecated paths include legacy scaffolding import, old backend retention, prototype-local artifacts, and API prefix drift. Every cross-domain claim has file:line citations plus a prophylactic hook to Q13/Q14/Q15.
